description: Ask what the tracked record shows about a named entity or unfolding event: what changed, what the record holds now, and which sources corroborate it. Not general knowledge or history — grounding is live tracked coverage. Costs one Read on an identified key (self-issue one free: POST /api/keys). Async — a ticket in ~1s, collected with get_answer.

fresh.description: Force a new synthesis instead of the maintained record's recent answer to the same question (default false — shared state is the default)

name: ask
